reviews.title: Great proof-reading tool
reviews.pros:
Open source and free (limited).

Grammar and spell checker.

Available as a standalone application and as a plugin for OpenOffice, Libre Office, Word.

Available as extensions for Chrome, Firefox and Edge.

Ability to run on your own instance.
reviews.cons: Limited language support - only supports 20 or so languages.
reviews.overall: LanguageTool is a must have grammar and spell check plugin which is available for most of the major office suites.
